headline: The demo that showed us the mouse

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen sixty-eight... a quiet engineer showed the world the future of computers.

scenes.label: Douglas Engelbart
scenes.caption: Engelbart (left), years later
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] In San Francisco, Douglas Engelbart sat before about a thousand computer experts.

scenes.label: live demo of a new kind of computing
scenes.text: [calmly] For ninety minutes, he showed them a little wooden box with wheels... the computer mouse.

scenes.label: The first mouse
scenes.caption: Replica, Computer History Museum
scenes.text: [softly] He also showed windows, linked text, and live video calls with his team, miles away.

scenes.title: The future, on one stage
scenes.text: [warmly] Things we now use every day... were first shown together, on one stage.

scenes.title: Could you live without a mouse?
scenes.text: [gently] Could you imagine life without a mouse?
